title: Critique a render at full density, not 4 cherry-picked frames
description: When evaluating a rendered Short, sample at 1fps minimum AND read every cached img_NN.png; declaring "the format works" from a handful of frames misses systemic failures the user will catch instantly.
body_excerpt: Rule: when critiquing a rendered Short, the floor for sample density is **every frame at 1fps + every cached `img_NN.png` in `data/cache/<slug>/`**. title: Every fix must consider the class-of-bug, not just this video
description: When fixing anything in ytFactory, classify the issue as one-off vs class-of-bug and fix the pipeline once at the schema/code level, not the artifact.
body_excerpt:
For ytFactory, when you find an issue (a critique flags something, a render looks bad, a prompt was wrong, a closer panel didn't show), do NOT just patch the single video.

**Why:** the user is building a factory — same backbone produces ≥10 Shorts/day across multiple channels. A one-off patch on this video is dead we…

title: Footage clip + black-intro pad must share the same framerate
description: Class-of-bug fix — `pipeline/footage.py` forces `-r 30` on both broadcast trim and concat output; without this a 25fps source + 30fps black-intro causes the concat re-encoder to drop ~2.7s of frames at the end, leaving the last seconds black while audio continues
body_excerpt:
`pipeline/footage.py:fetch_clip` now forces `-r 30` on TWO places:
1. The broadcast trim's output (the source video's native fps, often 25 for European broadcasts, gets forced to 30).
2. The concat output that glues the black-intro + broadcast together.

**Why:** caught on Iniesta v1. Source clip was 25fps AV1; the la…

title: GPU contention crashes make_shorts on M2 Max
description: Running 2+ make_shorts.py concurrently on the M2 Max causes Metal queue timeouts that look like clean exits; always verify mp4 + duration after a "completed" notification, and wait for GPU to clear before launching.
body_excerpt: The M2 Max GPU cannot reliably run two or more `make_shorts.py` instances at once — z_image_turbo / mflux thrash the Metal command queue and one of them throws `[METAL] Command buffer execution failed: Caused GPU Timeout Error` mid-step. Per-step time triples, then the Python process aborts via `std::runtime_error`.…

title: Guidance-distilled diffusion models AMPLIFY negated tokens
description: For z_image_turbo / mflux-schnell / any guidance-distilled model, NEVER mention a banned object — even with "no" / "avoid" / "without". The model pattern-matches the noun and renders it. Use only positive descriptors of what SHOULD be in frame.
body_excerpt:
Rule: on guidance-distilled image models (z_image_turbo, mflux schnell, similar), negation primes the rendering, not the absence. `(avoid: rugby ball)` produces a rugby ball. `no speech bubble in frame` produces an empty speech bubble. The model has no CFG to actually suppress; it's just attending to the tokens.

body_excerpt: `make_shorts.py` per-beat image cache used to check only `img_NN.png` existence. body_excerpt: **Rule:** When `force_positive` in channel YAML pins a color/aesthetic for a guest character, the LLM-authored scene + key_visual fields in `prompts.json` must NOT contain a competing color descriptor for the same character. title: No closer panel/captions — like+subscribe embedded in last beat image

title: One upload per render — never double-issue
description: Never POST /api/uploads AND run upload.py run for the same slug. Cancel the in-flight upload before starting another, regardless of method.
body_excerpt:
If an upload is already in flight (whether via `/api/uploads` POST or a running `.venv/bin/python upload.py run …` process), do NOT issue a second one for the same slug. The two paths share the same OAuth account → both will succeed → channel ends up with two duplicates of the same video, public.

title: Run /critique-audio after TTS, BEFORE image gen

When `pipeline/llm.py:call_claude_cli` is called with `json_schema=...`, the Claude CLI returns the validated object in `envelope["structured_output"]` while leaving `envelope["result"]` empty. The wrapper checks `structured_output` first in JSON-schema mode and only falls back to parsing `result` if missing.

title: compose._wipe_stale_per_beat_artefacts crashes on caption-prerender race
description: Background caption prerender + main-thread compose wipe race causes FileNotFoundError on word_*.png; the wipe is now FileNotFoundError-tolerant
body_excerpt:
**Rule:** `pipeline/compose._wipe_stale_per_beat_artefacts` swallows `FileNotFoundError` on `f.unlink()`. The wipe's intent is "make these files not exist" — if a file vanishes between glob and unlink (because another thread is touching it), the goal is met without surfacing an exception.

title: prompts.json fewer entries than beats crashes the render
description: pipeline/images._align_prompts_to_beats crashes when cached prompts.json has fewer entries than the current beat count; needs a guard that falls through to re-author
body_excerpt: **Rule:** When `m < n` (prompts < beats), `pipeline/images._align_prompts_to_beats` must return `None` (fall through to LLM re-author), not crash.
